title: Lipid Profile of Kratom Users
author: Mohammad Farris Iman Leong Bin Abdullah
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfuwjnxe

steps.title: Prepare Participants for Blood Collection
steps.instruction: Instruct participants to fast for 12 hours, beginning at 21:00 and arriving for collection at 09:00 the following day.

steps.title: Collect and Transport Blood Samples
steps.instruction: Collect blood samples from each participant for fasting lipid profile (FLP) and liver function test (LFT) using a phlebotomist.

substeps.instruction: Transfer blood samples to the laboratory within 1 hour.
Perform FLP and LFT analyses on the same day.

steps.title: Calibrate Biochemistry Analyser
steps.instruction: Calibrate the Beckman Coulter AU680 fully automated biochemistry analyser.

substeps.instruction: Use chemistry calibrator cat. 66300 for all test methods except HDL.
Use HDL-cholesterol calibrator ODC 0011 specifically for HDL.
Perform internal quality control procedure immediately following calibration in accordance with good laboratory practice.

steps.title: Perform Liver Function Tests (LFT)
steps.instruction: Quantify liver function markers using the Beckman Coulter AU680.

substeps.instruction: Quantify Total Protein (TP) using the biuret method (traceable to NIST SRM 972c).
Quantify Albumin using the bromocresol green method (traceable to IFCC CRM 470).
Calculate Globulin by subtracting albumin from total protein value.
Quantify Alkaline Phosphatase (ALP) using the kinetic colour (pNP) method (traceable to Beckman Coulter master calibration).
Measure Alanine Transaminase (ALT) and Aspartate Transaminase (AST) using the kinetic UV method (traceable to IFCC).
Quantify Total Bilirubin (TB) and Direct Bilirubin (DB) using the photometric colour test (diazonium salt), traceable to Beckman Coulter master calibrator and NIST SRM 916a respectively.
Calculate Indirect Bilirubin by subtracting direct bilirubin from total bilirubin value.

steps.title: Perform Fasting Lipid Profile (FLP)
steps.instruction: Quantify lipid markers using the Beckman Coulter AU680 via enzymatic color method.

substeps.instruction: Determine Triglyceride (TG) levels (traceable to isotope dilution mass spectrometry).
Determine Total Cholesterol (TC) levels (traceable to NIST SRM 909b Level 1).
Determine High-density lipoprotein (HDL) levels (traceable to the US Centre for Disease Control).
Calculate Low-density lipoprotein (LDL) via the Friedwald equation.

steps.title: Express and Record Results
steps.instruction: Report the quantified values using the following units:

substeps.instruction: TP, albumin, and globulin: g/L
ALP, ALT, and AST: U/L
Bilirubin: µmol/L
FLP findings (TG, TC, HDL, LDL): mmol/L
